result.summary: The home screen of a food delivery app is mostly well laid out. One clear visual defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a photo. Other cards have real images. A minor overlap issue also appears in the first 'Fastest near you' card.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a grey box with a broken-image icon instead of a food photo. The image failed to load. The card looks unfinished and inconsistent with the pizza card below, and it is the first large card users see.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or loading logic. Add a retry and a branded fallback placeholder (e.g. a restaurant illustration or blurred thumbnail) instead of a raw broken-image icon.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the '15–25 min' time pill on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps and extends past the plate image. Its left edge is also closer to the card edge than the pills on the other cards, so its position looks inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badges consistently (same left and bottom inset) on all cards, and make sure the image does not collide with the badge.

issues.description: Secondary grey text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', search placeholder, inactive tab labels) is light grey on a white or light background and may have low contrast. The white '€0 delivery' pill on the grey placeholder is also low-contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive icon colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).
